Azumarill

Water Fairy

Johto · Generation 2

Azumarill is a Water/Fairy-type Aqua Rabbit Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2). It stands 0.8 m tall and weighs 28.5 kg. It evolves from Marill. Its highest base stat is HP (100), with a base stat total of 420.
